Invariant. The cut is the platform runtime Z8, which lies *below* every adversary in scope; the predicate ranges over process and host behaviour, which Z8 holds natively.

Z4 mediates all model-bound traffic for X1 and X2 and can perform the registry lookup. X3 originates traffic outside the gateway, so Z4 ceases to be a cut; Z7 remains one but cannot see model identity, and the deficit becomes representational.

The application mediates the careless user's path and holds the review state. An injected agent reaches the governed effect without traversing the approval workflow, which is why §VIII‑E records this placement as one the method rejects under X2.
